# archestra_agent_email_address (Data Source)

Inbound email address provisioned for an agent (when the org's email-incoming feature is enabled). Use this to wire downstream SMTP/forwarding rules without copying the address by hand.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up the inbound email address provisioned for an agent. Useful for
# wiring downstream SMTP forwarders without copying the address by hand.
data "archestra_agent_email_address" "support" {
  agent_id = archestra_agent.support_bot.id
}

output "support_inbox" {
  value = data.archestra_agent_email_address.support.email_address
}

# Fail the plan loudly when incoming email is misconfigured at the org level.
# Surfaces a configuration-drift signal before the agent silently drops mail.
output "incoming_email_healthy" {
  value = (
    data.archestra_agent_email_address.support.provider_enabled
    && data.archestra_agent_email_address.support.agent_incoming_email_enabled
  )
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Target agent UUID.

### Read-Only

- `agent_allowed_domain` (String) Sender-domain allowlist enforced on inbound mail; null when no domain restriction is configured.
- `agent_incoming_email_enabled` (Boolean) True when the agent itself accepts inbound email.
- `agent_security_mode` (String) Inbound-email security posture for this agent (e.g. `dmarc_only`, `sender_allowlist`).
- `email_address` (String) The inbound email address the platform routes to this agent; null when incoming email is disabled at either the org or agent level.
- `provider_enabled` (Boolean) True when the org-level email provider is configured. False here means the agent address cannot be resolved regardless of agent-level settings.
